title: Barcode Sequencing by Illumina NGS
author: Nicholas A. Popp
materials: Prepare a lysis master mix of the following reagents and mix by vortexing briefly:

steps.title: Resuspend cell pellets in DPBS
steps.instruction: Resuspend each pellet in 100 µL DPBS for every 5 × 10⁶ cells; for 10 × 10⁶ cells use 200 µL and split into two separate tubes.

steps.title: Add cells to lysis master mix
steps.instruction: Add the resuspended cells (100 µL DPBS) to a properly labeled tube containing the lysis master mix and vortex to mix.

steps.title: Incubate lysate at 56 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the mixture at 56 °C with agitation at 1500 rpm for 30 minutes.

steps.title: Add ethanol and vortex lysate
steps.instruction: Spin the lysis tubes briefly, add 200 µL of 96–100 % ethanol to the lysed cells, vortex thoroughly, then spin the tubes again to remove drops from the lids.

steps.title: Transfer lysate to spin column
steps.instruction: Transfer the lysed cell mixture to a labeled DNeasy mini spin column placed in a 2 mL collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW1
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL Buffer AW1 (provided in kit) to the column, centrifuge at 6000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Wash column with Buffer AW2
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube, add 500 µL Buffer AW2 (provided in kit), centrifuge at 20 000 × g, °C, for 3 minutes, discard the flow‑through and collection tube.

steps.title: Centrifuge to remove residual buffer
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new 2 mL collection tube and centrifuge at 20 000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, then discard the tube.

steps.title: Elute DNA with molecular‑grade water
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL molecular‑grade water to the spin column, incubate at room temperature for 00:02:00, centrifuge at 6000 × g, °C, for 1 minute, and collect the eluate in a labeled 1.7‑mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Place column in new microcentrifuge tube
steps.instruction: Place the spin column in a new labeled 1.7‑mL microcentrifuge tube.

steps.title: Second elution with additional water
steps.instruction: Repeat the elution step with an additional 100 µL molecular‑grade water.

steps.title: Transfer split samples to tubes
steps.instruction: Transfer any split samples (pellets containing >5 × 10⁶ cells) into labeled 2.0‑mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Aliquot master mix into tubes
steps.instruction: Aliquot 322 µL of the master mix into labeled 1.7‑mL microcentrifuge tubes.

steps.title: Quantify DNA and store
steps.instruction: Quantitate the DNA with a Nanodrop and store the samples at –20 °C.
